name: Stalactite
summary: A mineral icicle growing down from a cave roof as dripping water leaves deposits.

name: Stalagmite
summary: A cone of stone growing upward where mineral-rich drops reach a cave floor.

name: Geode
summary: A hollow rock lined with crystals formed from mineral-rich solutions.

name: Obsidian
summary: A dark volcanic glass formed when molten rock cools very quickly.

name: Basalt
summary: A dark volcanic rock that forms when lava cools and solidifies.

name: Granite
summary: A hard speckled rock formed by the slow cooling of magma underground.

name: Limestone
summary: A sedimentary rock frequently built from ancient seashells and marine remains.

name: Marble
summary: A patterned stone produced when limestone is transformed by heat and pressure.

name: Erosion
summary: The gradual wearing away of land by moving water, wind and weather.

name: Sediment
summary: Small particles of rock and soil carried and deposited by water or wind.

name: Amber
summary: Golden fossilized tree resin that can preserve insects for millions of years.

name: Quartzite
summary: Tough metamorphic rock made when quartz-rich sandstone is heated and compressed.

name: Pumice
summary: A lightweight volcanic rock filled with bubbles from trapped volcanic gas.

name: Magma Chamber
summary: An underground reservoir of molten rock that can feed an active volcano.

name: Fault Line
summary: A fracture through the Earth where masses of rock may move past each other.

name: Rock Cycle
summary: The continuous transformation of rocks through melting, erosion and pressure.

name: Mangrove
summary: A salt-tolerant coastal tree with arching roots that shelter fish and shorelines.

name: Otter
summary: A playful semi-aquatic mammal that hunts fish in streams and coastal waters.

name: Heron
summary: A tall wading bird that waits patiently for fish in shallow water.

name: Tadpole
summary: A young amphibian with a tail that transforms as it grows into a frog.

name: Newt
summary: A small amphibian that spends part of its life in ponds and damp habitats.

name: Marsh
summary: A shallow wetland where grasses and reeds dominate the landscape.

name: Bog
summary: An acidic waterlogged habitat that slowly accumulates peat and moss.

name: Lagoon
summary: A shallow body of coastal water sheltered from the open sea.

name: Clam
summary: A two-shelled mollusc that burrows in sand and filters water for food.

name: Mussel
summary: A dark-shelled mollusc that anchors itself to rocks and filters seawater.

name: Kelp
summary: A large brown seaweed that forms underwater forests in cool coastal water.

name: Reef
summary: A shallow underwater ridge that provides habitat for a wealth of marine life.

name: Coral
summary: A colony of tiny marine animals that can build remarkable limestone structures.

name: Lily Pad
summary: A floating circular leaf that helps an aquatic lily reach sunlight.

name: Reed
summary: A tall flexible wetland plant that bends with the wind beside waterways.

name: Salt Marsh
summary: A coastal wetland where salt-tolerant plants flourish in tidal water.

name: Yeast
summary: A microscopic fungus that makes dough rise by fermenting sugars.

name: Croissant
summary: A buttery layered pastry that bakes into a golden crescent.

name: Bagel
summary: A ring-shaped bread traditionally boiled before being baked.

name: Pretzel
summary: A baked twisted bread with a distinctive looped shape and golden crust.

name: Pancake
summary: A soft round breakfast cake cooked in a pan from a pourable batter.

name: Waffle
summary: A crisp patterned breakfast cake cooked between two hot patterned plates.

name: Cinnamon
summary: A fragrant spice from the dried inner bark of certain evergreen trees.

name: Vanilla
summary: A sweet aromatic flavor made from the cured pods of a tropical orchid.

name: Cake
summary: A sweet baked dessert often layered with icing for special occasions.

name: Caramel
summary: Golden cooked sugar that adds a rich toasted sweetness to desserts.

name: Popcorn
summary: Light puffed kernels that pop when moisture inside them turns to steam.

name: Rice
summary: Small edible grains grown on a grass that thrives in flooded fields.

name: Noodles
summary: Long strands of dough cooked in water and enjoyed in countless cuisines.

name: Dumpling
summary: A small pocket of dough filled or folded then steamed, boiled or fried.

name: Syrup
summary: A thick sweet liquid made by dissolving sugar or reducing plant juices.

name: Pie
summary: A baked dish with a pastry crust around a sweet or savory filling.

name: Lens
summary: A shaped transparent piece that bends light to form or magnify images.

name: Prism
summary: A transparent solid that refracts light and separates it into colors.

name: Optics
summary: The scientific study of light, vision, reflections and image formation.

name: Film
summary: A light-sensitive sheet used to capture photographs or moving pictures.

name: Photograph
summary: A captured still image that can preserve a moment of the world.

name: Negative
summary: A photographic image in which bright and dark tones are inverted.

name: Darkroom
summary: A light-controlled room where photographic film and prints are developed.

name: Flash
summary: A brief brilliant burst of light used to illuminate a camera scene.

name: Tripod
summary: A stable three-legged stand that keeps cameras steady during exposure.

name: Shutter
summary: A camera mechanism controlling how long light reaches the image sensor.

name: Projector
summary: A device that casts enlarged images onto a distant screen.

name: Slide
summary: A transparent photograph or image intended for projection onto a screen.

name: Photographer
summary: A person who creates pictures by choosing light, framing and timing.

name: Exposure
summary: The amount of light reaching a photographic surface over time.

name: Portrait
summary: An image that focuses on the likeness and expression of a person.

name: Aperture
summary: An adjustable opening in a lens that controls how much light enters.
